# Feature contract

<!-- Generated by `make contract` from src/recsys/features/contract.py. Do not edit. -->

## Point-in-time rules

- Every gold table is keyed by a cutoff T (`cutoff_date`, UTC midnight).
- Features for T use only events with `event_ts < T`. Labels use `[T, label_end)`.
- Event categories come from the catalog value valid at each event's own time (`item_properties_scd`). Item catalog features ("as of T") use the value valid just before T, so a version first observed exactly at T is not visible (ADR-005).
- Windows are trailing: a `Nd` feature covers `[T - N days, T)`. Sessions break after 30 minutes of inactivity.
- Leakage is tested by `tests/test_leakage.py`: adding events at or after T, or catalog changes after T, must not change any feature row.

## Cutoffs

| split | cutoff T | label window |
|---|---|---|
| train | 2015-07-24 | [2015-07-24, 2015-08-07) |
| train | 2015-08-07 | [2015-08-07, 2015-08-21) |
| val | 2015-08-21 | [2015-08-21, 2015-09-04) |
| test | 2015-09-04 | [2015-09-04, 2015-09-18) |

## `gold/user_features`

One row per (cutoff, visitor) for visitors with at least one event before T.

| name | type | window | nulls | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cutoff_date` | date | - | never null | Snapshot time T (UTC midnight). Partition column. |
| `split` | string | - | never null | train / val / test. |
| `visitor_id` | int | - | never null | Visitor. Rows exist only for visitors with an event before T. |
| `days_since_first_event` | double | all history | never null | Days from first event to T. |
| `days_since_last_event` | double | all history | never null | Days from last event to T. |
| `days_since_last_view` | double | all history | null if the visitor never had a view | Days from last view to T. |
| `days_since_last_addtocart` | double | all history | null if the visitor never had a addtocart | Days from last addtocart to T. |
| `days_since_last_transaction` | double | all history | null if the visitor never had a transaction | Days from last transaction to T. |
| `n_events_total` | bigint | all history | never null | Events before T. |
| `n_sessions_total` | bigint | all history | never null | Sessions before T. |
| `n_views_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | View events. |
| `n_addtocart_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Add-to-cart events. |
| `n_transactions_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Transaction events. |
| `n_sessions_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Sessions with an event in the window. |
| `n_distinct_items_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Distinct items interacted with. |
| `n_views_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | View events. |
| `n_addtocart_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Add-to-cart events. |
| `n_transactions_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Transaction events. |
| `n_sessions_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Sessions with an event in the window. |
| `n_distinct_items_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Distinct items interacted with. |
| `view_to_cart_rate_7d` | double | 7d | null if n_views_7d = 0 | add-to-carts / views, clipped to [0, 1]. |
| `cart_to_purchase_rate_7d` | double | 7d | null if n_addtocart_7d = 0 | transactions / add-to-carts, clipped to [0, 1]. |
| `view_to_cart_rate_30d` | double | 30d | null if n_views_30d = 0 | add-to-carts / views, clipped to [0, 1]. |
| `cart_to_purchase_rate_30d` | double | 30d | null if n_addtocart_30d = 0 | transactions / add-to-carts, clipped to [0, 1]. |
| `n_categories_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Distinct categories (as of each event's time) interacted with. |
| `top_category_id_30d` | int | 30d | null if n_categories_30d = 0 | Category with the highest affinity score (ties: lowest id). |
| `top_category_share_30d` | double | 30d | null if n_categories_30d = 0 | Top category's share of the visitor's total affinity score. |

## `gold/user_category_affinity`

One row per (cutoff, visitor, category) with a positive score.

| name | type | window | nulls | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cutoff_date` | date | - | never null | Snapshot time T (UTC midnight). Partition column. |
| `split` | string | - | never null | train / val / test. |
| `visitor_id` | int | - | never null | Visitor. |
| `category_id` | int | - | never null | Category of the item at event time (point-in-time). |
| `affinity_score` | double | 30d | never null | Sum of event weights (view=1, addtocart=3, transaction=5). Always > 0. |
| `affinity_share` | double | 30d | never null | affinity_score / visitor's total score. |

## `gold/item_features`

One row per (cutoff, item) for items with an event before T or a catalog version valid at T.

| name | type | window | nulls | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cutoff_date` | date | - | never null | Snapshot time T (UTC midnight). Partition column. |
| `split` | string | - | never null | train / val / test. |
| `item_id` | int | - | never null | Item with an event before T or a catalog version valid at T. |
| `category_id` | int | as of T | null if the item has no catalog version valid at T | categoryid valid at T. |
| `root_category_id` | int | as of T | null if the item has no catalog version valid at T, or category not in tree | Root of category_id. |
| `category_level` | int | as of T | null if the item has no catalog version valid at T, or category not in tree | Depth of category_id (root = 0). |
| `available` | int | as of T | null if the item has no catalog version valid at T | Availability flag (0/1) valid at T. |
| `days_since_first_event` | double | all history | null if no events before T | Days from first event to T. |
| `days_since_last_event` | double | all history | null if no events before T | Days from last event to T. |
| `n_views_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | View events. |
| `n_addtocart_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Add-to-cart events. |
| `n_transactions_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Transaction events. |
| `n_visitors_7d` | bigint | 7d | 0 if none | Distinct visitors. |
| `n_views_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | View events. |
| `n_addtocart_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Add-to-cart events. |
| `n_transactions_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Transaction events. |
| `n_visitors_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Distinct visitors. |
| `coview_neighbors_30d` | bigint | 30d | 0 if none | Distinct items viewed in the same session (sessions of 2..50 items). |
| `copurchase_neighbors_total` | bigint | all history | 0 if none | Distinct items bought in the same transaction. |
| `popularity_rank_7d` | int | 7d | null if no weighted events in the window | Dense rank by weighted event score (1 = most popular). |
| `popularity_rank_30d` | int | 30d | null if no weighted events in the window | Dense rank by weighted event score (1 = most popular). |
| `cart_rate_30d` | double | 30d | never null | (carts + 20·global_rate) / (views + 20), clipped to [0, 1]. |
| `purchase_rate_30d` | double | 30d | never null | (transactions + 20·global_rate) / (views + 20), clipped to [0, 1]. |

## `gold/labels`

One row per (cutoff, visitor, item) with an interaction in the label window. Not a feature: never join it into model inputs.

| name | type | window | nulls | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cutoff_date` | date | - | never null | Snapshot time T (UTC midnight). Partition column. |
| `split` | string | - | never null | train / val / test. |
| `visitor_id` | int | - | never null | Visitor with an event in [T, label_end). |
| `item_id` | int | - | never null | Item interacted with in the label window. |
| `relevance` | int | label window | never null | Max grade of the label-window events (view=1, addtocart=2, transaction=3). |
| `n_label_events` | bigint | label window | never null | Events on this pair in the window. |
| `first_label_ts` | timestamp | label window | never null | First event on this pair in the window. |
| `viewed` | boolean | label window | never null | Any view in the window. |
| `carted` | boolean | label window | never null | Any add-to-cart in the window. |
| `purchased` | boolean | label window | never null | Any transaction in the window. |
| `is_repeat` | boolean | all history | never null | Visitor interacted with this item before T. |
| `visitor_has_history` | boolean | all history | never null | Visitor has any event before T (false = cold start). |
